page.notes: Tacitus reference: a printed symbol stands before "Annal." that I could not identify; it is left out. Hebrew phrases (Gen./Isa. and Ps. 36:7) are read from a small, faint scan and the order of the letters in "זרע קדש מצבתה" is uncertain. The Greek word before "statio" (Isa. 6:13 LXX) is faint and uncertain. "fecilitatem" and "confiictari" are printed as such. The Greek of Rom. 11:33 is read from the scan; the word after "&" with its hyphen is faint. Marginal note: "imperfctu-tabilia" is printed with long s and hyphen, transcribed as imperscrutabilia. Catchword "prehendi" is the continuation of the word "reprehendi" at the foot.
